xBRIEFInfo.description: Temporary test/local kill-switch via root .deft-directive-disable (distinct from #2926 permanent opt-out).

plan.title: feat(policy): `.deft-directive-disable` test kill-switch (file + AGENTS/CLI/doctor; re-enable needs new session)

narratives.Description: Add a temporary test/dev kill-switch so operators can turn Directive enforcement off without permanent project opt-out and without deleting the deposit. The locked flag is root `.deft-directive-disable` (gitignored). Presence disables hooks, session ritual, and automation while allowing `.deft/core` to remain. This is distinct from `.no-deft-directive` (#2926 permanent opt-out), which treats flag+deposit as inconsistent.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer running A/B or DevHammer tests, I want a gitignored local kill-switch that disables Directive enforcement without removing the deposit, so that I can re-enable by deleting the flag and starting a new session without permanent opt-out semantics.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Add packages/core/src/policy/deft-directive-disable.ts with detector, recovery message (file gone + new session), and gitignore constant; deposit/docs ensure `.deft-directive-disable` is gitignored; committed flag is doctor warn only. 2. Wire shared detector into hooks SessionStart/PreToolUse/compact, CLI ritual/mutating verbs, and doctor as explicit disabled (test kill-switch) not #2926 dirty path. 3. Add AGENTS always-on contract (agents-entry + refresh) to check flag before further Directive process load. 4. Precedence: disable flag first (deposit OK), then .no-deft-directive, else normal; both flags combined message. 5. Unit/hook tests for detection + short-circuit; permanent opt-out path unchanged. 6. Docs distinct from no-deft-directive.md; CHANGELOG + consumer note for A/B / DevHammer.
narratives.Overview: Temporary test kill-switch: root `.deft-directive-disable` (gitignored). Deposit may stay. Recovery = delete file + new agent session. Not permanent opt-out (#2926).
narratives.Labels: enhancement, doctor, agent-experience, process, tooling, vendored-deposit, area:cli, testing
narratives.NonGoals: Auto-delete .deft/ or uninstall deposit; replace/weaken .no-deft-directive; rewrite AGENTS to stub on disable; org-remote kill switch; nested monorepo package roots; DEFT_DISABLED env (optional later).

narrative.Acceptance: When root .deft-directive-disable is present, the shared detector returns present=true and deposit/docs ensure the flag path is gitignored so new commits reject tracking it.

items.title: Hooks CLI doctor short-circuit on flag

narrative.Acceptance: When the flag is present, SessionStart hooks skip ritual bookkeeping, ritual CLI verbs emit the recovery message and exit without writing ritual state, and doctor reports disabled test kill-switch without #2926 flag-plus-deposit dirty failure.

items.title: AGENTS always-on contract and recovery text

narrative.Acceptance: When agents read AGENTS after agents:refresh, the always-on contract blocks further Directive process load and shows recovery text that requires deleting the flag and starting a new session before full operation claims.
Given only .no-deft-directive, permanent opt-out behavior is unchanged; given only the disable flag with deposit present, unit and hook tests validate short-circuit and CHANGELOG records #3039.
